questions.question: What major obstacle did Dr. Bibha Chowdhuri face as a female scientist in the 1930s?

questions.question: Elaborate on Dr. Bibha Chowdhuri's contribution to Indian science and why her recognition in 2019 was historically significant.
questions.answer: Dr. Bibha Chowdhuri was a trailblazer who conducted foundational nuclear research on cosmic rays and mesons when Indian science was dominated by men. Despite lacking adequate equipment and being overlooked during her lifetime, she worked alongside global giants like Blackett and Bhabha. The IAU naming a star 'Bibha' in 2019 restored her to her rightful place in global scientific history, inspiring future generations of young women in STEM.
questions.explanation: Structural analysis derived directly from text evidence.
